text: １ど　なげて　つかまらなくても　あきらめないで　なんども　ボールを　なげてみて！

structure.jp: ボールを　なげてみて！

patterns.name: 〜なくても
patterns.explanation: なくても on a verb says 'even if it does not happen'. つかまらなくても = 'even if it isn't caught'.

patterns.name: 〜ないで
patterns.explanation: ないで on a verb says 'without doing that', and goes on to what you do instead. あきらめないで = 'without giving up'.

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: みる after a て verb says you try doing it to see what happens; ending in て makes it a friendly request. なげてみて = 'try throwing'.
